install.notes: setup.py:11-15 requires pyboy<2.0.0, gymnasium>=0.29 and numpy; the upstream environment also imports skimage, mediapy and matplotlib (environment.py:5-16,24) and reads a Pokemon Red ROM (pyboy_binding.py:43). The gate and the fake backend need none of them: fake.py is pure Python, and package code never imports the clone. Install and supply the ROM only to serve the real environment, which was not run.
